findings_critical.title: ActiveX legacy dependencies in 3 forms
findings_critical.details: Forms use MSComctlLib.TreeCtrl.2 + MSComctlLib.ImageListCtrl.2 (pre-.NET COMCTL32 OCX). On modern Windows without MSCOMCTL.OCX registered (or 64-bit Access), these fail to instantiate — silent tree empty. Modern port: use built-in TreeView/ImageList or migrate to web.

findings_critical.title: Reach-up-to-grandparent coupling
findings_critical.details: Form_FormVideosGestionArbolVideoDatos.Form_Load does `Set m_Arbol = Me.Parent.Parent.Controls("Arbol").Object`. Hard-coded 2-level navigation up the form hierarchy to grab TreeCtrl. If parent form is reparented or stacked differently, this breaks silently. Also: uses On Error GoTo without Resume — failures are masked.

findings_critical.title: Twin forms with subtle routing divergence
findings_critical.details: FormVideosGestion (editor) routes to FormVideosGestionArbolVideo → which routes to FormVideosGestionArbolVideoDatos (edit). FormVideosUsuarios (read-only) routes to FormVideosArbolVideo → which routes to FormVideoDetalle. The naming 'VideosArbolVideo' vs 'VideosGestionArbolVideo' is the disambiguator. Same ActiveX, same structure — easy to confuse in migration.

findings_critical.title: No automated test coverage for any G4 form
findings_critical.details: codegraph blast radius shows '⚠️ no covering tests found' for every Form_Form* in the lanzaderas module. All forms rely on global state (m_ObjVideoActivo, m_ObjAplicacionActiva) — hard to test in isolation without refactoring to dependency injection.

findings_critical.title: Marco17 OptionGroup overlap false positives
findings_critical.details: Forms #4 and #6 report 14 overlap findings each because Marco17 (OptionGroup container) geometrically contains all child controls. analyze_form_layout reports this as overlap but it's intentional containment. Not a real bug — known limitation of strict AABB lint.
